groqResponse: {"answer":"The outage was caused by two independent bugs: the Cloud Run backend was stuck on a stale image tag, and the Vercel frontend had required environment variables set to empty strings, which bypassed the nullish‑coalescing fallback and caused every request to use a blank base URL, resulting in silent failures.","citations":[{"sourceRef":"dealhunter:silent-outage"}],"followUps":[{"question":"How was the outage resolved?","sourceRef":"dealhunter:silent-outage"},{"question":"What fallback logic failed on the frontend?","sourceRef":"dealhunter:silent-outage"},{"question":"What lessons were learned from this incident?","sourceRef":"dealhunter:silent-outage"}]}
